summary: Confirmed DONE. 60633eff3 (#710), which is also in the Hub-vendored 7bc39eec3, delivers every part of the proposal. It adds the providerEventLogs off/lifecycle/full setting with a RYCO_PROVIDER_EVENT_LOGS override; env=off returns NoOpProviderEventLoggers. The default is full in dev and lifecycle when packaged, and changes hot-apply through serverSettings.streamChanges. An age plus total-size sweep runs at boot and then hourly for both logs/provider (30 d, 512 MiB) and logs/terminals (90 d, 256 MiB). Rotated backups are gzipped through zlib. Diagnostics now reads the newest canonical per-thread files instead of the nonexistent events.log. I found no production path that bypasses the mode: no driver passes nativeEventLogPath, so the adapters' own fallback loggers (default mode full) are test-only. ProviderService takes eventLoggers.canonical. The field state matches the code: ~/.ryco/userdata/logs/provider is now 505 MiB in 170 files, down from 4.1 GB in 689. Every rotated .log.N file dates from Oct 10-12, before the update. Files written since are 1-500 KB and contain only lifecycle types (session.*, task.*, turn.*, claude/system/init, claude/result/success), with no deltas. Out-of-scope sibling, not part of this finding: a CLI node installed as a launchd/systemd service sends all console output to logs/service.log in append mode with no rotation (nodeService.ts:141-144, :172-173). That file is unbounded on long-running nodes. In web mode server.log is still never written, which is already tracked as bug-table item 506.
correction: Small line-number slips only. EventNdjsonLogger.ts:49 is the LogDirectoryRetention interface. sweepLogDirectory starts at :66 and its oldest-first budget pass is at :98-110, not :80-92. makeEventNdjsonLogger is at :217, not :214. None of this changes the classification.

evidence.note: The retention sweep runs for both targets, then repeats every hour (Schedule.spaced(1h)) in a forkScoped fiber. With env=off the layer returns NoOpProviderEventLoggers, so drivers pass no logger.

Mode resolution: env override, then the setting, then the build default (full when devUrl is set, otherwise lifecycle). It is re-resolved on every settings change (:170-183) and read on every write (:186).
logs/provider: 30 d plus 512 MiB. logs/terminals: 90 d plus 256 MiB. Terminal history files are full rewrites capped at 2 MiB (Manager.ts:82, :1264, :1383), so sweeping one only drops old scrollback.
sweepLogDirectory: an age pass, then unlink oldest-by-mtime until the total fits maxTotalBytes (:98-110). It never fails (catch at :112-116), so the hourly repeat cannot die.
writeRecord checks the mode before resolveWriter, so mode off (or a filtered record) creates no file and does no I/O. The only cost is the mode check.
The lifecycle policy: a canonical type allowlist, native lifecycle-name matching, and exclusion of delta/progress/stream_event/token/item records.
Rotation gzips the .1 backup through compressBackup (:382-392, zlib pipeline, tmp file then rename, falls back to the uncompressed backup on failure).
readProviderEventFailures reads the 128 KiB tail of the 8 newest current canonical <thread>.log files and parses runtime.error, failed turns and errored exits. Called at :897.

The adapter fallback makeEventNdjsonLogger (default mode full, no compression) runs only when nativeEventLogPath is passed. git grep finds no non-test caller that passes it, so the mode cannot be bypassed in production.
The canonical logger comes from the shared ProviderEventLoggers, so the same mode and retention apply.

505 MiB in 170 files, under the 512 MiB budget (4.1 GB in 689 files at report time). Rotated .log.N files all predate the update. A current thread holds 305 KB canonical / 148 KB native with only lifecycle record types.
Out-of-scope sibling: the launchd StandardOutPath/StandardErrorPath and the systemd append: (:172-173) send all CLI-node console output to logs/service.log with no rotation.

fixDefects: None that reopen the finding. Residuals, all minor or out of scope: (1) The packaged default is lifecycle, not off. The proposal allowed this, and the field data shows delta volume is gone. (2) If off is set through the setting instead of the env var, adapters still call write(), which returns after a mode check. Cost is negligible. (3) There is no web UI control for providerEventLogs; it is reachable only through settings.json or the env var, as documented in docs/observability.md:61-64. (4) ServerDiagnostics.observability.providerEventLogPath still reports the nonexistent provider/events.log path, but the web UI does not display it. (5) Sibling outside this finding: the CLI service's logs/service.log is unbounded, and web-mode server.log is unwritten (bug-table item 506).
implementationSketch: Nothing remains for this finding. Optional sibling follow-up, kept separate. In ServerLoggerLive (apps/server/src/serverLogger.ts:107-123), also write the rotating server.log in web mode. When running under the service manager (an env flag such as RYCO_SERVICE=1 set in the launchd plist and systemd unit generated by apps/server/src/service/nodeService.ts), drop Logger.consolePretty so service.log keeps only crash/stderr output. Alternatively, point StandardOutPath at the rotating file and have `ryco service logs` tail server.log. Tests: extend serverLogger.test.ts for the web-mode file logger, and nodeService tests for the env flag in the generated plist and unit.
